title: 第6章 给你吃大白兔奶糖
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
此时，周香兰正风情万种的倚靠在小卖部柜台前，摇着一把扇子，远远看见火急火燎的李大壮，就笑盈盈的逗弄起他来。

    只可惜，现在的李大壮是真着急，没心情欣赏她的风骚：“香兰姐！快把你摩托三轮借我用用，我爸出事了，我得赶紧去镇上！”

    “你这傻小子说啥胡话呢？你爸早晨走的时候还好好的，能出啥事儿？你要是闲着没事儿干，就跟姐去屋里，陪姐做个游戏打发时间好不好？”

    周香兰本是嫁到杏花村来的，但她男人在外面找了小三，常年不回家，两年前干脆跟她离了婚，她从嫁过来就在村里开着小卖部，离婚了也无处可去，正好她前夫也不回老家，她就继续在这儿干着。

    不过离了婚的女人，总归是寂寞，尤其是最近，天一热，她丰腴的身体和一颗春心，都跟着躁动起来，每天夜里不自己动动手，压根就睡不着。

    这会儿她看着高大帅气，浑身冒着热气的李大壮，那股空虚和寂寞又冒了出来，烧的她大白天就快受不住了，香汗滴滴流淌，勾人的美眸，仿佛生出了透明的黏丝，粘在了李大壮的身上！

    “大壮，姐说真的，姐屋里有大白兔奶糖，你跟姐进屋，姐就给你……”

    周香兰实在忍不住了，哪怕李大壮是个傻子，也比她见过的别的男人都招人稀罕，她迫不及待拉着李大壮的手往里屋拽！

    李大壮却急的头顶都要冒火了：“香兰姐！现在不是说这个时候！我爸真的出事了，我得赶紧去镇上，你借我摩托三轮，我晚上回来还你，到时你想让我吃啥都行！”

    “真的吃啥都行？”周香兰忍不住幻想起某些画面，顿时浑身发软，情不自禁的靠向大壮宽厚的胸膛，丰满的娇躯，因为激动微微颤抖着，雪白的圆润，刺激着李大壮的胸口！

    李大壮着急的说：“香兰姐，只要你赶紧把三轮车钥匙给我，真的吃啥都行！”

    周香兰顿时嗔笑起来，语气暧昧的若有所指：“你这傻小子，虽然脑子不灵光，但这张嘴还挺招人稀罕的，又能说，又能吃……”

    李大壮无语了：“香兰姐，我脑子确实是好了，但我看你的脑子好像是骚坏了！”

    “你不借拉倒，我去别人家！”李大壮实在没时间跟周香兰扯这些黄磕，扭头就要走。

    周香兰这才意识到不对劲，李大壮着急的表情和眼神，好像跟正常人没啥两样，难道，他真不傻了？
content_en:
Li Qiu Shuang didn't know what she wanted Li Dazhuang to do, but she knew that only Li Dazhuang could do this, and only Li Dazhuang could extinguish the fire on her...

    She couldn't help but wrap herself around Li Dazhuang's tall body with the purest yet charming gesture!

    This clumsy eagerness made Li Dazhuang's whole body feel hot. The secret method unique to the Hehuan Sect was about to stir inside his body...

    He couldn't bear it any longer, so he grabbed Li Qiu Shuang's thin waist with his two big hands and twisted it with a little force...

    Li Qiu Shuang couldn't help but raise her slender neck, her mouth opened slightly, and she gasped with an uncontrollable moan.

    "Hmm~~ Da Zhuang, so hot~~~~~"

    Li Dazhuang was so angry that he put his fiery hands through the thin summer clothes and finally...

    "Ah~~~"

    Li Qiu Shuang screamed even louder. Her gentle and beautiful eyes were filled with eager longing, and her fair and delicate face also had a trace of blush, just like the bunch of ripe red grapes on your grape vine in the yard. They were so bright that people couldn't help drooling just by looking at them!

    Li Dazhuang couldn't bear it any longer and kissed that rosy face...

    After tasting it, I realized that Li Qiu Shuang's taste was simply more delicious than red grapes full of sweet water. Her face was fragrant and her lips were fragrant...

    And Li Qiu Shuang seemed to melt into the river behind the village, paralyzed softly and feebly in Li Dazhuang's arms!

    Just when the two were about to take a step forward, Li Qiu Shuang's old-fashioned cell phone suddenly rang!

    "Hmm~" Li Qiu Shuang was trembled by the harsh ringtone, and she became much more awake. Seeing the state of herself and her silly brother, her already red face turned even redder with embarrassment. She hurriedly tried to take out her phone, but accidentally touched Li Dazhuang...

    It made Li Dazhuang groan!

    "Sister Qiu Shuang, please stop answering, I feel bad!" Li Dazhuang, like before, was cheating on his adopted sister.

    Normally, Li Qiu Shuang would have really obeyed him, but now she had come to her senses and felt ashamed. As a strong adopted sister, she seduced him like this when he was stupid. This was too shameless!

    "No, no! Sister, you have to answer the phone first!" Li Qiu Shuang was so embarrassed that she couldn't sit down anymore and struggled to get up from Li Dazhuang's arms.
title_en: Chapter 5 Sister, be my woman and I will protect you
